All times are seconds from clip start (offset within the clip
file, NOT the source recording).

ClipAnalysis.description:
Per-clip source-analyzer response.

Contains the PRIMARY payoff (top-level fields) plus optional
`additional_moments` for clips where the user got multiple kills.
The compile treats each moment as its own sub-clip in the final
montage — a 40s Outplayed clip with 3 kills becomes 3 tight
~5s sub-clips.

Backward compat: pre-v4 sidecars don't have `additional_moments`;
they still deserialize (Pydantic defaults it to []).

additional_moments.description: Extra payoffs in the same clip (kills at the beginning AND end, common when the user pre-clipped their own VOD). Each moment gets rendered as its own sub-clip in the montage. Windows may NOT overlap with the primary or each other.
additional_moments.title: Additional Moments

buildup_start_seconds.description: Where meaningful engagement begins for the primary payoff.
buildup_start_seconds.title: Buildup Start Seconds

confidence.description: 0..1 confidence in the primary payoff + its trim window. Below `vlm_clip_analyzer_min_confidence` the compile ignores the trim and uses the full clip as fallback.
confidence.title: Confidence

description.description: One-sentence account of what happens in the clip.
description.title: Description

payoff_anchor_seconds.description: The single most impactful payoff frame. If nothing worth highlighting is in the clip, put the midpoint here and set confidence low.
payoff_anchor_seconds.title: Payoff Anchor Seconds

resolution_end_seconds.description: Where the aftermath of the primary payoff resolves.
resolution_end_seconds.title: Resolution End Seconds

ClipAnalysis.title: ClipAnalysis

FlagCategory.description:
What a montage critic flags on an interval. Tuned for gameplay
critique; adding a member is safe, nothing branches on the value.
FlagCategory.title: FlagCategory

MomentFlag.description: One flag on a specific interval of the montage.

end_s.description: End of the flagged interval, in seconds from montage start.
end_s.title: End S

fix_seconds.description: Magnitude of the fix in seconds, 0-5 range. Required when suggested_fix is anything other than drop/keep/None.
fix_seconds.title: Fix Seconds

start_s.description: Start of the flagged interval, in seconds from the beginning of the montage. Will be snapped to the nearest panel boundary.
start_s.title: Start S

suggested_fix.description: The deterministic op the refine loop should apply. Set for actionable flags (kill_anchor_misplaced -> shift, cut_too_early -> extend_after, boring_pacing -> trim). Leave None for positive flags (great_moment, payoff_lands) and observations that don't map to a mechanical fix.
suggested_fix.title: Suggested Fix

why.description: One-sentence, specific explanation. Reference what is visible: "killfeed shows tpew killing HitTheQuang -- teammate frag, not user's".
why.title: Why

climax_strength.description: 1-5: how strongly the biggest moment lands.
climax_strength.title: Climax Strength

flags.description: Zero or more intervals worth flagging. Include BOTH problems (dead air, scoreboard shots, own deaths) AND highlights (great_moment, good_buildup) so the caller can see what worked. Chronological order preferred.
flags.title: Flags

opener_strength.description: 1-5: how strongly the first ~5 seconds hook the viewer.
opener_strength.title: Opener Strength

overall_verdict.description: `ship_it` -- no material issues, publish as-is. `needs_edits` -- a few flagged moments to fix. `start_over` -- pacing or content fundamentally broken.
overall_verdict.title: Overall Verdict

top_recommendation.description: One-sentence: the single biggest change that would improve the montage. Actionable -- name the interval and what to do.
top_recommendation.title: Top Recommendation
